analysis_status: Second exploratory planning study. The first pilot found no eligible separation at reliability 0.95; this registry asks whether smooth target concentration is informative at reliability 0.99 while expectation-only corrections remain uninformative.
selection_rule: Require boundary validation at or below 0.05, smooth-certificate power at reliability 0.99 of at least 0.80, and power at most 0.10 for both expectation-only certificates. Select the fewest releases, then the smallest target, then the largest smooth-certificate power, then the narrower ramp. If no cell qualifies, do not run a confirmation.
